simple.summary: בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן (Bêyth Baʻal Mᵉʻôwn) means Beth-Baal-Meon , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Jer 48 23.

definitions.full: H1010. Beth Baal Meon מְעוֺן בַּ֫עַל בֵּית proper name, of a location Joshua 13:47, = מְעוֺן בַּעַל Num 32:38 ; Ezek 25:9 ; 1Chr 5:8 (MI מען בעל & מען בעל בת ) = מְעוֺן בֵּית Jer 48:23 = בְּעֹן Num 32:3 (read probably מען ; compare Dr Sm lxviii ); city assigned to Reuben Josh 13:17 ; Num 32:3 , 38 ; 1Chr 5:8 ; possessed by Moab Jer 48:23 ; Ezek 25:9 ; — modern Ma±în Tristr Moab 303 f. Schick ZPV ii. 1879, 5 Survey EP i. 176 Bd Pal 192 .
definitions.rootNote: from 1004 and 1168 and 4583 ; house of Baal of (the) habitation of (apparently by transposition); or (shorter) בֵּית מְעוֹן lemma בֵּית מעוֹן missing vowel, corrected to בֵּית מְעוֹן ; house of habitation of (Baal);
